name: dsh-text-editor
description: In-app Monaco text editor for the DSH Web GUI, living in the right Sidebar. The browser half registers an `extension`-band right-Sidebar resource tab type for `dsh-resource://file/**`, so every text file opened from the workspace file tree or a conversation file link is edited (and saved) in place; images and PDF keep the built-in document preview. It also still provides the 'dsh-text-editor' client service (ctx.provide): openFile (open a path in the right-Sidebar editor) and showDiff (a 差异 tab in the conversation area, manually advanced). Host half (index.ts) registers read/write/Monaco routes.

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check index.ts && node --check host/read.ts && node --check host/write.ts && node --check host/monaco.ts && node --check host/http.ts && node --check host/types.ts
